Evidence: An expert panel in India has recommended granting regular market approval for Covishield and Covaxin, which are currently authorized for emergency use. This recommendation was made on January 19, 2022, and the approval is subject to certain conditions. The expert committee reviewed applications from Serum Institute of India and Bharat Biotech, which included data on safety and efficacy. The committee's recommendations will be sent to the Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) for final approval (Source 3). There is no mention of a review for full market approval for Sputnik V in the retrieved evidence.
Justification: The retrieved evidence indicates that an expert panel has recommended regular market approval for Covishield and Covaxin, but it does not mention any review for full market approval for Sputnik V. Therefore, the claim that an expert committee will review full market approval for Covishield and Sputnik V is not supported by the evidence, as it only discusses Covishield and Covaxin (Source 3).
